UPDATE agent_session
            SET thread_id = $2,
                originating_message_id = $3,
                bot_id = $4,
                model = $5,
                harness = $6,
                repo_url = $7,
                acp_session_id = $8,
                status = $9,
                status_event_name = $10,
                modified_at = $11
            WHERE id = $1
